title: Prove domain and side conditions before applying a partial construction
obstacle: A function or theorem is available only for data satisfying a specified domain condition.
procedure: Read the complete domain and hypotheses of the intended application.
Prove membership and other required conditions from the current permitted inputs.
Apply the construction to the qualified data and retain the condition in later interface transfers.
verification: Compile the exact application without introducing additional assumptions.
positive_example: Construct an element of a subtype only after proving its predicate.
negative_example: Treat a partially defined construction as applicable to arbitrary data.

evidence.note: Editorially generalized guidance under this maintenance policy; no independent effectiveness result or proof acceptance is claimed.
